verdict.rationale: OpenCode documents a GitHub integration where it can be asked to fix an issue or implement a feature, working in a new branch and submitting a PR autonomously (opencode-docs-12), and 'opencode serve' can run headlessly and be accessed remotely (opencode-docs-30, opencode-comm-7), which is a building block for always-on operation. However there is no documented scheduling mechanism (cron-like triggers), no dedicated 'always-on agent' daemon mode, and community feedback notes sessions getting stuck on long/nested tasks and security concerns when the server is left running unauthenticated (opencode-comm-8, opencode-comm-18). Missing for 10: explicit schedule/cron trigger configuration, first-party docs on autonomous maintenance loops, and evidence of reliable long-running unattended operation.
